name: reliability_v1
notes: Stability is a relative model-stability proxy, not a calibrated uncertainty; see calibration.json for what was and was not shown.
Only tiles whose reference passed the registration gate are analysed; excluded tiles are listed with machine-readable reasons in metrics.jsonl and here.
Datasets are analysed separately and never pooled.

provenance.name: sen2sr_lite
provenance.note: the published inference system: CNN + clamp to >= 0 + low-frequency Fourier hard constraint (512x512 mask) inside every tile
provenance.value_convention: reflectance fraction = stored DN / the dataset's reflectance_scale (10000); no BOA offset applied, no clipping by FRAME

provenance.name: sen2sr_mamba
provenance.note: SEN2SR-Mamba RGBN through the isolated worker: MambaSR + clamp to >= 0 + low-frequency hard constraint, float32 (no autocast)
provenance.value_convention: reflectance fraction = stored DN / the dataset's reflectance_scale (10000); no BOA offset applied, no clipping by FRAME

tta.definition: frame.uncertainty.run_tta_ensemble over frame.tiling.TiledModel: the model is run on each geometric view of the whole scene and every prediction is de-transformed; stability = per-pixel population standard deviation over the members, averaged over the four bands; the product evaluated is the ensemble mean
